body.name: Canonical projective Cholesky predictor
body.construction: For \(S_j^{\pi}=\{i:\pi^{-1}(i)<\pi^{-1}(j)\}\), set \(B_{j,S_j^{\pi}}^{\pi}(C)=C[j,S_j^{\pi}]C[S_j^{\pi},S_j^{\pi}]^{-1}\), \(B_{j,V\setminus S_j^{\pi}}^{\pi}(C)=0\), and \(v_j^{\pi}(C)=1-C[j,S_j^{\pi}]C[S_j^{\pi},S_j^{\pi}]^{-1}C[S_j^{\pi},j]\). Put \(A^{\pi}(C)=(I_p-B^{\pi}(C))^{-1}\) and \(\Phi_e^{\pi}(C;d)=\operatorname{corr}(A^{\pi}(C)\operatorname{diag}(v^{\pi}(C))D_eA^{\pi}(C)^{\mathsf T})\).
